items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: If a trumpet player had walked in and sounded as good as Pettiford sounded over Chubby and sounded that good over me, I'd be shaking like that, too, man.

ctx.x: Yeah. Chubby didn't like that shit. I can understand that...
We're talking about Chubby Jackson, of course.
